title: Enforce a maximum quantity limit per product in the cart
intent: Add a maximum quantity limit per product.
acceptance_criteria: Adding a quantity above config.max_quantity_per_product for one product is rejected
Adding a quantity at or below the limit still succeeds
The limit applies to the cumulative quantity of a product already in the cart plus the new amount
expected_risks: config.max_quantity_per_product already exists and is read elsewhere via get_settings() — this is a validation wiring change in CartService.add_item/update_item_quantity
The limit must be checked against the cumulative cart quantity, not just the single request, to be meaningful
expected_tests: adding more than the per-product limit is rejected
adding up to the limit still succeeds (regression)
expected_failure_modes: CartService only checks available inventory, not a per-product maximum (current gap)
